Third-party stylesheets and fonts bundled in this folder.

| File | Library | Version | License | Source |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| leaflet.css | Leaflet | 1.9.4 | BSD-2-Clause | https://github.com/Leaflet/Leaflet/releases/tag/v1.9.4 |
| fontawesome/css/fontawesome.min.css | Font Awesome Free | 6.5.1 | MIT (code) | https://github.com/FortAwesome/Font-Awesome/releases/tag/6.5.1 |
| fontawesome/css/solid.min.css | Font Awesome Free | 6.5.1 | MIT (code) | https://github.com/FortAwesome/Font-Awesome/releases/tag/6.5.1 |
| fontawesome/webfonts/fa-solid-900.woff2 | Font Awesome Free | 6.5.1 | SIL OFL 1.1 (fonts), CC BY 4.0 (icons) | https://github.com/FortAwesome/Font-Awesome/releases/tag/6.5.1 |
| fontawesome/webfonts/fa-solid-900.ttf | Font Awesome Free | 6.5.1 | SIL OFL 1.1 (fonts), CC BY 4.0 (icons) | https://github.com/FortAwesome/Font-Awesome/releases/tag/6.5.1 |

Notes:

- Font Awesome versions come from the banner in the two CSS files. Font Awesome
  Free is under three licenses at once: MIT for the code, SIL OFL 1.1 for the
  fonts and CC BY 4.0 for the icons. CC BY 4.0 requires attribution, which this
  file provides.
- leaflet.css carries no banner. It is the stylesheet shipped with the Leaflet
  1.9.4 release, the same version as templates/js/vendor/leaflet.js.
- The scripts are listed in templates/js/vendor/VERSIONS.md.
